comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: This was very hard to watch. It shines a strong light on the slave economies of the United States and the Spanish, French and Portugese colonies in the New World. These powers had a strong interest in reviling Haitian independence and torpedoing it at every turn, since it was a screaming indictment of their systems. Later came Social Darwinism with its bogus racial justifications of asserted superiority and inferiority. Sainte Domingue generated fabulous wealth – there was a French expression - ‘riche comme un Creole‘ – for the wealth of the plantation owners. Double debt cripples a fledgeling nation. The reparations demanded by Prussia in 1871 led to the French revenge at Versailles in 1921, which led to the Third Reich as revenge rather than let bygones be bygones. The comfortable blasé attitude of arm-chair experts to the effects of crushing debt is all too human.      I worked at a medical mission near Les Cayes in 1972. I did clinics in the Peninsule de Tiburon, in the Massif de la Hotte and the Chaine de la Selle. I also visited Jacmel. What a sensation for me to learn from you that Alexandre Pétion gave sanctuary to Simon Bolivar in 1815 at Les Cayes, providing him with material and infantry support, and then resupplying him at Jacmel!! This vital aid played an indispensible role in Bolivar’s success in liberating the countries of what would make up Gran Colombia. I have swum in the Rivière de la Sud where it flows into the Caribbean. Going 3 metres back and forth one can alternate cold water from the mountains and warm water from the Caribbean. There is a clear view of Ile la Vache. This was where Sir Francis Bacon had his hidden redout from which he attacked the galleons of the Spanish Main. They never did discover his hiding place. Near Les Cayes I visited the sugar plantation where John James Audubon was born. Built solidly of stone, one has the impression that the owner will reappear at any moment. The Haitians are long suffering but decent reliable people. The current chaos is teaching the young that they must either emigrate or live in a hell of violence. Thank you for your sensitive handling of the material.
